name: longest
text:
LONGEST SAMPLE (fictional). This card is the stress case for the legibility floor.

“The committee met on the third Tuesday of the month” — that sentence is quoted exactly as supplied, including its dash, its quotation marks and its accented names: Zoë, Renée, Søren, Łukasz.

Paragraph three repeats the point at some length so that the fitting code has to choose a smaller size: the text must be shown whole, in the order given, and never shortened to make it fit.

Paragraph four: figures such as 12 500 and 3.5 % stay together because the spaces between them are non-breaking.

Paragraph five closes the card with a final line.
